No. With the Moon’s altitude at **−31.3°**, it is far below your local horizon—more than 30 degrees below it—so it is physically blocked by the Earth and cannot be seen from Reykjavík at that time.

The clear sky, dark conditions, 11% illumination, and your eyesight would not change that. Its azimuth of about **333°** only tells you it is below the north-northwest horizon in that direction.

The Sun is also well below the horizon (**−44.1°**), so the sky is genuinely dark, but the Moon will not be visible until it rises later.
